text:
nina_cs: Heads up- NovoHealth (acct 7721) invoice #8010 failed autopay. Card declined twice and then gateway returned 'do_not_honor'. Customer on a new enterprise pilot; they say treasury ops will wire. Need to pause auto-retries and provide wire details.

omar_fin: share gateway decline details and last4. Also do we have a PO?

nina_cs: last4 8811. Declines: `card_declined`, `do_not_honor`. Attempts at 2026-03-23T11:02Z and 11:25Z. PO provided earlier in onboarding: PO-4409.

billing-bot: Payment log: invoice=8010 customer=NovoHealth attempts=2 status=failed gateway=Stripe-us region=us-east-1

jordan_sales: Sales flagged this as high-priority. They need production access restored ASAP. Suggest manual invoice with wire as primary and a one-time pay link as fallback. Please ensure we disable auto card retries.

rachel_billing: agree. I'm ok creating a manual invoice and setting payment_method=wire. Need written confirmation that treasury will initiate wire and the beneficiary reference they'll include. Also waive one late fee.

nina_cs: I'll request confirmation now; customer message: "Treasury will wire by EOD, please send beneficiary details and exact reference: Invoice 8010 / PO-4409."

omar_fin: ok create manual invoice, set payment_method=wire, waive late fee. Keep audit trail. Once SWIFT copy received, attach to ticket and reconcile.

jordan_sales: I'll follow up with treasury contact and cc billing.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4576 for manual-wire settlement invoice 8010.

rachel_billing: Action items: nina_cs to capture confirmation and SWIFT MT103 when available (eta EOD), omar_fin to create manual invoice and disable card auto-retries, jordan_sales to escalate with customer treasury.

nina_cs: On it. Will update thread when we have SWIFT confirmation. Thanks.
